_comment: The character pipeline's own model file. It is not the recreation pipeline's templates.json, and the recreation scripts never read it. The character scripts (scripts/character/generate.sh and the model command of scripts/character/state.py) read it to refuse an impossible request before it costs anything, and to compute cost. Same shape as known_model_limits in templates.json, plus min_duration_s. MiniMax H3 is the default. Add another model only with a measured cap and price.

output._comment: Generate at 768p, 9:16. Upscale once to 1080x1920 at assembly (lanczos). Never 4K. 9:16 is the only size for now; more sizes are added later when needed.

duration_rules._comment: The recreation rules (state.py model set, generate.sh, AGENTS.md rules 6 and 7), restated for the character copies, with this model's minimum.
duration_rules.whole_seconds: The duration is a whole number of seconds, from min_duration_s (5) to max_duration_s (15). Supagen allows 5 to 15 for this model. A segment planned shorter than 5 s is generated at 5 s and trimmed at assembly.
duration_rules.cap: Check the range when the model is chosen (state.py model set) and again before each generation (generate.sh).
duration_rules.unknown_model: Refuse a model slug that is not in known_model_limits.
duration_rules.duration_field: Set video_settings.duration to null and put the integer in extensions.duration. fal serialises an integer duration as "20s" and rejects its own string.
duration_rules.resolution_field: Put the resolution in extensions as "768P" (uppercase), beside the duration.
duration_rules.cost: Computed cost = price_per_s x seconds. It is a computed figure, not the billed amount (see supagen_findings.billing).
duration_rules.active_version: The REST invoke endpoint ignores version_number and runs the active version. Change the active version (activate_version over MCP) and the selected model (state.py model set) together, never one without the other.

supagen_findings._comment: Read-only check on 2026-10-02 through the Supagen MCP: the model record, the versions of the earlier reference template, the invocation list and one trace. No generation.
supagen_findings.price: price_per_s 0.06 is the 768p price set on 2026-10-02. Supagen's model record lists $0.13 per second.
supagen_findings.billing: PARTLY OPEN. Supagen records $0.65 for every run of this model (seven runs, 5 to 15 s, 9:16 and 16:9): the list price x the 5 s minimum, whatever the duration. MiniMax H3 Max shows the same pattern ($0.20 a run). So Supagen's cost record is per run. What the provider charges cannot be read from Supagen: compare the provider account after the first paid run. Until then, plan each run at $0.65 as the worst case.
supagen_findings.template_settings: SETTLED. The earlier reference template had three versions: aspect_ratio 9:16, n 1, extensions {duration: 15, 5 or 6, resolution: "768P"}, audio on at 15 s and off at 5 and 6 s. The ugc-character template does not exist in Supagen yet. It is created with these settings before the first paid run, after a yes; nothing before that needs it.
supagen_findings.resolution: SETTLED. Allowed: 480p, 768p, 2K, 4K (768p native; 2K and 4K are provider upscales). "768P" in extensions worked in every run. Send that; upscale to 1080p at assembly.
supagen_findings.output_length: SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT. Outputs run 0.1 to 0.6 s long: 5 s gave 5.184 s, 6 s gave 6.592 s, 15 s gave 15.104 s. Trim to the planned length at assembly.
